mentions.name: Librium
mentions.description: This macOS document library app indexes files in place so existing folder structures stay intact, working with local, external, network, and cloud folders. It adds tagging, collections, and user-defined attributes, and offers search with on-device text extraction and OCR. Currently in TestFlight beta and headed to App Review.
mentions.problem: Other document apps pull files into their own databases or reorganize files into their own folders; Librium indexes files in place instead, leaving the existing folder structure intact.
mentions.source_excerpt: I’m working on a document library app for macOS with tagging, collections and user attributes. Unlike other apps that pull files into their own databases or reorganize files into their own folders, Librium indexes files in place, so your existing folder structure stays in tact. It works with folders on your local drive in addition to external and network drives and the cloud. Search works with on-device text extraction and OCR.
mentions.author: jdechko
